                            KEY IMPROVEMENTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. DESIGN PATTERNS IMPLEMENTED
   ✓ Strategy Pattern (GraphTraversal interface)
   ✓ Template Method Pattern (AbstractGraphTraversal)
   ✓ Builder Pattern (GraphBuilder)
   ✓ Facade Pattern (GraphAnalyzer)
   ✓ Factory Methods (DepthFirstSearch.recursive/iterative)

2. ENHANCED GRAPH CLASS
   ✓ Input validation (non-negative vertices, no self-loops)
   ✓ Edge removal capability
   ✓ Duplicate edge prevention
   ✓ Unmodifiable neighbor lists
   ✓ Utility methods: hasEdge(), getDegree(), getVerticesWithDegree()
   ✓ Graph properties: isEmpty(), getAllVertices()

3. TRAVERSAL ALGORITHMS
   ✓ DFS - Recursive and Iterative implementations
   ✓ BFS - Standard queue-based implementation
   ✓ Both implement common GraphTraversal interface
   ✓ Both extend AbstractGraphTraversal for code reuse

4. ADVANCED ANALYSIS FEATURES
   ✓ Connected Components Analysis
     - Find all connected components
     - Check if graph is connected
     - Get component membership for each vertex
   
   ✓ Cycle Detection
     - Detect presence of cycles
     - Identify vertices in cycles
   
   ✓ Path Finding
     - Find path between any two vertices
     - Calculate distance between vertices
     - Optional return type for safe handling
   
   ✓ Graph Metrics
     - Vertex count, edge count
     - Vertex degree, degree distribution
     - Graph density calculation

5. CODE QUALITY IMPROVEMENTS
   ✓ Consistent naming conventions
   ✓ Single Responsibility Principle
   ✓ Dependency Injection
   ✓ Immutable return types where appropriate
   ✓ Comprehensive error handling
   ✓ Null-safe operations using Optional
   ✓ Clear separation of concerns

6. EXTENSIBILITY
   ✓ Easy to add new traversal algorithms (implement GraphTraversal)
   ✓ Easy to add new graph analysis features
   ✓ Abstract base class provides common functionality
   ✓ Analyzer facade aggregates multiple tools

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                          ARCHITECTURAL LAYERS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Layer 1: Core Data Structure
  └─ Graph: Adjacency list with validation

Layer 2: Traversal Algorithms
  ├─ GraphTraversal (interface)
  ├─ AbstractGraphTraversal (base implementation)
  ├─ DepthFirstSearch (DFS variant)
  └─ BreadthFirstSearch (BFS variant)

Layer 3: Graph Analysis
  ├─ ConnectedComponentsAnalyzer
  ├─ CycleDetector
  └─ PathFinder

Layer 4: High-Level API
  ├─ GraphBuilder (fluent construction)
  └─ GraphAnalyzer (unified analysis)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                          USAGE EXAMPLES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Build a graph fluently
Graph graph = new GraphBuilder(6)
    .addEdge(1, 2)
    .addEdge(0, 3)
    .addEdge(2, 0)
    .addEdge(5, 4)
    .build();

// Analyze comprehensively
GraphAnalyzer analyzer = new GraphAnalyzer(graph);
GraphAnalyzer.AnalysisResult result = analyzer.analyze();

result.getVertexCount();           // Get vertex count
result.getEdgeCount();              // Get edge count
result.isConnected();               // Check connectivity
result.hasCycle();                  // Check for cycles
result.getDensity();                // Calculate density
result.getConnectedComponents();    // Find components
result.findPath(0, 5);              // Find path between vertices
result.getDistance(0, 5);           // Get path length

// Use individual analysis tools
List<Integer> dfs = DepthFirstSearch.recursive().traverse(graph);
List<Integer> bfs = new BreadthFirstSearch().traverse(graph);

ConnectedComponentsAnalyzer comp = new ConnectedComponentsAnalyzer(graph);
List<List<Integer>> components = comp.findConnectedComponents();

PathFinder finder = new PathFinder(graph);
Optional<List<Integer>> path = finder.findPath(0, 5);

                            TESTING VERIFIED
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✓ Traversal correctness (DFS, BFS produce expected results)
✓ Connected components detection (simple & disconnected graphs)
✓ Cycle detection (correctly identifies cyclic vs acyclic graphs)
✓ Path finding (finds valid paths and distances)
✓ Graph metrics calculation
✓ Input validation (catches invalid vertices)
✓ Edge cases (single vertex, empty neighborhoods)
